track: Yugaantar DevForge Track 4 - Trust, but verify
assumptions: Adapter relies on operating-system isolation of TRACK4_STATE_DIR and caller authentication when invoked by the judging worker or local orchestrator.
Full multi-user authentication, RBAC, distributed key rotation, and MySQL-backed persistence are enforced in the Spring Boot backend.
In-database audit hash chain detects non-privileged row edits but cannot stop an adversary with full database write + checkpoint access.
